description: This Java source file defines the SendThingMessage class, which represents a command to send a message to a specific IoT Thing within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances, including from JSON representations, and specifies related constants and internal structure.

classes.name: SendThingMessage
classes.description: A command class to send a message to a specified Thing in the Eclipse Ditto system, supporting various creation methods including JSON deserialization.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders for this message command, returning a new instance with updated headers.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a SendThingMessage instance with a ThingId, message payload, and DittoHeaders.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a SendThingMessage from a JSON string or JSON object, using a provided headers object.
